cases.q: 发电量最高的 10 个电站
cases.sql: SELECT p.plant_name, ROUND(SUM(g.generation_kwh), 0) AS total_generation_kwh FROM fact_daily_generation g JOIN dim_plant p ON g.plant_id = p.plant_id GROUP BY p.plant_id, p.plant_name ORDER BY total_generation_kwh DESC, p.plant_name LIMIT 10
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.plant_name AS plant_name, ROUND(SUM(f.generation_kwh), 0) AS gen FROM dim_plant p JOIN fact_daily_generation f ON f.plant_id = p.plant_id GROUP BY p.plant_id ORDER BY gen DESC, p.plant_name LIMIT 10

cases.q: 本月等效利用小时排名前 5 的省份
cases.sql:
SELECT p.province, ROUND(SUM(f.generation_kwh) / SUM(p.capacity_mw) / 1000, 2) AS equivalent_hours
FROM fact_daily_generation f
JOIN dim_plant p ON f.plant_id = p.plant_id
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', f.stat_date) = '2026-08'
GROUP BY p.province
ORDER BY equivalent_hours DESC, p.province
LIMIT 5
cases.expected_sql: SELECT province, ROUND(SUM(gen) / SUM(cap) / 1000, 2) AS eq FROM (SELECT p.province AS province, p.plant_id, SUM(f.generation_kwh) AS gen, p.capacity_mw AS cap FROM dim_plant p JOIN fact_daily_generation f ON f.plant_id = p.plant_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', f.stat_date) = '2026-08' GROUP BY p.plant_id) GROUP BY province ORDER BY eq DESC, province LIMIT 5

cases.q: 本月发电量较去年同期增长多少
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND((cur.gen - prev.gen) * 1.0 / prev.gen, 4) AS yoy_growth_rate
FROM (
  SELECT SUM(generation_kwh) AS gen
  FROM fact_daily_generation
  WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', stat_date) = '2026-08'
) cur
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT SUM(generation_kwh) AS gen
  FROM fact_daily_generation
  WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', stat_date) = '2025-08'
) prev
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND((cur-prev)/prev,4) AS yoy FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',stat_date)='2026-08' THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS cur, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',stat_date)='2025-08' THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS prev FROM fact_daily_generation)

cases.q: 山东省本月发电量环比上月变化
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND((cur.gen - prev.gen) / prev.gen, 4) AS mom_change
FROM (
  SELECT SUM(generation_kwh) AS gen
  FROM fact_daily_generation f
  JOIN dim_plant p ON f.plant_id = p.plant_id
  WHERE p.province = '山东' AND strftime('%Y-%m', f.stat_date) = '2026-08'
) cur
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT SUM(generation_kwh) AS gen
  FROM fact_daily_generation f
  JOIN dim_plant p ON f.plant_id = p.plant_id
  WHERE p.province = '山东' AND strftime('%Y-%m', f.stat_date) = '2026-07'
) prev
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND((cur-prev)/prev,4) AS mom FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',f.stat_date)='2026-08' THEN f.generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS cur, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',f.stat_date)='2026-07' THEN f.generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS prev FROM fact_daily_generation f JOIN dim_plant p ON p.plant_id = f.plant_id WHERE p.province = '山东')

cases.q: 今年前三季度发电量同比去年
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND(
  (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', stat_date) = '2026' AND CAST(strftime('%m', stat_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', stat_date) = '2025' AND CAST(strftime('%m', stat_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END))
  * 1.0 /
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', stat_date) = '2025' AND CAST(strftime('%m', stat_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END)
, 4) AS yoy_generation_ratio
FROM fact_daily_generation
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND((cur-prev)/prev,4) AS yoy FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y',stat_date)='2026' AND CAST(strftime('%m',stat_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS cur, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y',stat_date)='2025' AND CAST(strftime('%m',stat_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS prev FROM fact_daily_generation)

cases.q: Q2 发电量环比 Q1 变化多少
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND((q2.q2_gen - q1.q1_gen) * 1.0 / q1.q1_gen, 4) AS qoq_change
FROM (
  SELECT SUM(generation_kwh) AS q1_gen
  FROM fact_daily_generation
  WHERE strftime('%Y', stat_date) = '2026'
    AND CAST(strftime('%m', stat_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3
) q1,
(
  SELECT SUM(generation_kwh) AS q2_gen
  FROM fact_daily_generation
  WHERE strftime('%Y', stat_date) = '2026'
    AND CAST(strftime('%m', stat_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6
) q2
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND((q2-q1)/q1,4) AS mom FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y',stat_date)='2026' AND CAST(strftime('%m',stat_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS q2, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y',stat_date)='2026' AND CAST(strftime('%m',stat_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS q1 FROM fact_daily_generation)

ORDER BY month

cases.q: 按设备类型统计各电站故障次数，取前 10
cases.sql:
SELECT d.device_type, p.plant_name, COUNT(*) AS fault_count
FROM fact_device_fault f
JOIN dim_device d ON f.device_id = d.device_id
JOIN dim_plant p ON f.plant_id = p.plant_id
GROUP BY d.device_type, p.plant_name
ORDER BY fault_count DESC, p.plant_name
LIMIT 10
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.plant_name AS plant_name, d.device_type AS device_type, COUNT(*) AS fault_cnt FROM fact_device_fault fl JOIN dim_device d ON d.device_id = fl.device_id JOIN dim_plant p ON p.plant_id = fl.plant_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY fault_cnt DESC, p.plant_name, d.device_type LIMIT 10
